planets.name: TOI-277 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-277 with a 3.99-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-277 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-277. Its orbit and size follow Magliano et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
